rows.product_effect: Do not mix with other months.

rows.product_effect: Exact epoch receipt required for joins.

rows.value: The downloadable files are open under the Open Government Licence and use CSV with double-quote text delimiters where applicable.
rows.product_effect: Ingest parser and attribution gate.

rows.product_effect: Current all-premises bulk contract.

rows.product_effect: Residential revision namespace is distinct from all-premises r2.

rows.value: All-premises and residential postcode files are separate folders and must not be unioned without a premise_type key.
rows.product_effect: Prevent duplicate/mixed denominators.
rows.evidence: Derived directly from official file inventory.

rows.value: At postcode and output-area level gigabit coverage is published, but full-fibre coverage is withheld for commercial confidentiality.
rows.product_effect: Missing full-fibre field is not zero or NO_DATA for gigabit.

rows.value: Postcode files provide compact postcode, single-space postcode and postcode-area fields.
rows.product_effect: Normalize only with official identity forms.

rows.value: All Matched Premises counts premises linked to at least one fixed-provider record with a non-zero predicted download speed.
rows.product_effect: Matched is not the same as total premise base.

rows.value: Unmatched premises are classified as unclassified rather than zero-speed matched records.
rows.product_effect: Do not coerce unclassified to zero coverage.

rows.value: SFBB is at least 30 Mbit/s; UFBB fields separately cover at least 100 and at least 300 Mbit/s; gigabit is separately identified.
rows.product_effect: Preserve metric names and thresholds.

rows.value: Unable to receive 2/5/10/30 Mbit/s percentages are defined over matched premises.
rows.product_effect: Do not divide by all premises.

rows.value: Unable to receive decent fixed/FWA includes unmatched records and zero predicted speeds, with 10 Mbit/s down and 1 Mbit/s up thresholds.
rows.product_effect: Different denominator from unable-X fields.

rows.value: Coverage figures are fixed-line only except where FWA is explicitly named in the field.
rows.product_effect: No implicit fixed/FWA aggregation.

rows.value: Local-authority take-up uses active residential and business full-fibre connections.
rows.product_effect: Do not compare directly with residential-only headline coverage.

rows.value: The premise base targets addresses where an end-user service would be delivered, including sub-properties rather than parent containers.
rows.product_effect: Property identity must reflect serviceable units.

rows.value: Parent-shell containers are excluded while eligible child service-delivery addresses are retained.
rows.product_effect: Do not score a block shell as a household/business premise.

rows.value: Premises require accepted AddressBase postal indicators and logical_status=1 approved addresses.
rows.product_effect: Open UPRN alone is insufficient.

rows.value: BLPU state must be null or 2 under Ofcom's published premise-base query.
rows.product_effect: Exclude incompatible lifecycle states.

rows.value: Commercial, residential, dual-use and selected objects of interest are included by explicit classification-code rules.
rows.product_effect: Do not infer premise type from postcode percentages.

rows.value: Provider records are preferentially matched through UPRN hierarchy relationships.
rows.product_effect: Exact UPRN evidence remains primary.

rows.value: Confident address matches require building number/name, street and postcode; approximate matches use street and postcode.
rows.product_effect: Approximate address match cannot establish exact parcel identity here.

rows.value: Provider records matched only to postcode and records with no geographic assignment are excluded from Ofcom analysis.
rows.product_effect: No postcode-only rescue for parcel rows.

rows.value: Ofcom did not use postcode-based estimates for unmatched premise records in its fixed coverage analysis.
rows.product_effect: Nearest-postcode estimation remains forbidden.

rows.value: Planned Network Deployments is forward-looking and supplements, rather than replaces, the January 2026 current-coverage snapshot.
rows.product_effect: Planned coverage cannot upgrade a current-r2 row.

rows.value: A plan is High Confidence only when low-level design is complete and funding is committed.
rows.product_effect: Still future evidence, not current service availability.

rows.value: The same premise may be targeted by multiple providers at different times and confidence levels.
rows.product_effect: Preserve multiplicity and time horizon.

rows.value: Planned FWA analysis records qualifying mast locations; individual-property matching is not undertaken.
rows.product_effect: No parcel availability from planned mast proximity.

rows.value: OS Open UPRN includes under-construction, in-use and demolished UPRNs.
rows.product_effect: Lifecycle filtering is mandatory before current-premise use.

rows.value: The product is a whole-GB full supply in CSV or GeoPackage; AOI and change-only updates are unavailable.
rows.product_effect: Require full-supply release/hash receipt.

rows.value: GeoPackage FID is autogenerated and non-persistent; the 12-digit UPRN is the persistent identifier.
rows.product_effect: Never join across releases by FID.

rows.value: AddressBase Premium exposes logical status, BLPU state/date and optional parent UPRN alongside official BNG position.
rows.product_effect: Use exact lifecycle and hierarchy fields.

rows.value: A UPRN can have multiple LPIs, but when one address is needed only the single logical_status=1 approved LPI should be selected.
rows.product_effect: Reject arbitrary first/nearest address labels.

rows.value: An application awaiting registration can have a title number while estate interest and class of title are absent.
rows.product_effect: Pending title cannot be treated as completed registered-title metadata.

rows.value: Registered Status='Pending' means processing; blank means the title is registered.
rows.product_effect: Parse blank as an explicit registered state, not missing data.

rows.value: Change Indicator is New/Changed/Deleted; monthly full, change-only and validation files are available from the second working day.
rows.product_effect: Delete handling and validation-file receipt are mandatory.
